## Event Improvements -- MCP-Only Discovery (2026-09-13)

Owner-directed: connect to Kosmos-Oden via MCP only, find Event improvements. Both MCP servers used (Kosmos-Oden plugin search_notes/get_note; Observatory gkos_navigation_discover). No SSH for data retrieval.

### Discovery volume

search_notes hits: Event 17, Chronicle 50, Stream 14, Broadcast 3, BIS 1, Jumbotron 1, Tournament 3, Scribe 2 = 103 total across 8 terms. get_note retrieved 12 documents in full (largest 41,316 chars, no truncation). Observatory navigation returned 6 Event paths.

### 6 distinct workstreams

1. fac-events registration plugin (FAC/Technology/Event_Workflow + Website-Workspace)
   REGISTRATION-WORKFLOW v0.2 (22,889 chars): standalone WP plugin, phased. Phase 0 Google Form + Calendar (only thing that truly ships in days), REG-1 native registration 2-3 weeks (fac_person_id not yet in fighter contract), REG-2 coordinator-editable, REG-3 pit/broadcast projections. Queue PIT_STAGING -> ON_DECK -> NEXT_UP -> IN_COMBAT -> COMPLETE bout-based. Armor Gray/Amber/Blue/Red/Green; Green only from event-day inspector. Identity fac_person_id + Google iss/sub never email. IANA tz. 48HR-DISPOSITION v1.3 (30,806 chars): direct-to-live owner decision, intake flag off at deploy, production cache isolation mandatory, rollback drill split into code/scoped-tables/full-site. Two-Week Execution Plan (14,763 chars): design 8.5/10 delivery 6.5/10, integrated release target 2026-09-20.

2. Broadcast Interaction Service BIS (LuSaur_Tech/2026-08-10_FAC/11_LIVE_EVENTS_BIS_JUMBOTRON_STREAMING_AND_SOCIAL.md)
   One authoritative service for jumbotron, Realm Companion, Twitch Extension, web viewers, TikTok, OBS overlays. Fan Duel fallback LOCAL/LOCAL -> LOCAL/REMOTE -> REMOTE/REMOTE -> crowd boss; digital never delays real bouts. Director Console. Event types FAN_DUEL, LINEAGE_EVOLUTION, FORM_TRANSMISSION, HOUSE_DUEL, CROWD_BOSS, TRIVIA, SUPPORTER_CHALLENGE. Ceremony discipline EVIDENCE -> VERIFIED GRANT -> CEREMONY. bout_blocking=NEVER. BIS-Local signed offline state. Social Clip Factory: 7 derivations per event. Story graph suggestions never create facts.

3. Broadcast infrastructure modernization (FAC/Technology + FAC_Docs)
   Replace RTMP with SRT (UDP packet-loss tolerant for metal-cage arenas) + WebRTC VDO.Ninja sub-500ms + NDI local ingest; Datarhei Restreamer replaces NGINX. All free/open-source. TWINE: two near-identical copies of the v2.0 reconstruction document (38,612 + 41,316 chars) -- dedup candidate.

4. Athlete Chronicle + seasons (LuSaur 2026-08-10_FAC/04)
   Six domains BANNER/LINEAGE/LAURELS/OATHS/RELICS/FORMS. Permanent FIGHTER_ID, immutable season snapshots, append-only errata. Silhouette over total score. Career/Casual/Ranked rulesets. Chronicle/adapter/ruleset version axes stamped separately.

5. Fan Chronicle + Cross the Line (LuSaur 2026-08-10_FAC/09)
   ALLEGIANCE/SUPPORTER PATH/WITNESS/SERVICE/COLLECTION. Spectator -> ... -> Steward; no fan title outranks real Squire. Career Mode recruitment funnel ends at real-training RSVP. Cross the Line promotion FAN -> ATHLETE chronicle. Consent-based conversion metrics for grants/sponsors.

6. Event scaling + operations (FAC/FAC_Docs/FAC_Volunteer_Guide + FAC/Documents)
   Small/Medium/Large staffing matrices. Events_Playbook: I-10 corridor scouting, media collection standards, lyst network, armor acquisition support.

### Assessment

- The six workstreams are interdependent (registration feeds BIS; BIS consumes Chronicle; broadcast serves jumbotron) but NO plan cross-references another. The LuSaur 2026-08-10_FAC numbered design series (01-14) and the FAC website-workspace plans read as two separate design conversations about the same event system.
- Chronology: LuSaur designs 2026-08-10, registration plans 2026-09-07. The 09-07 registration docs appear to be the more current engineering track.
- If claude or codex know the implementation status of fac-events (was the 2026-09-20 target met?), that is the missing verification layer -- vault plans record intent, not deployment.

### No action requested

Discovery report for awareness. The dedup candidate (broadcast architecture mirror pair) is flagged for whichever lane owns FAC website content hygiene.
